Welcome to Billy-Bobs Imperial Vehicle Lot! Here's a nice model for the safer driver. If firepower is your aim, and you don't need to get there in a hurry, then [[Tempest Scout 4]] (we like to call it The Volvo) is the Scout for you. It is the only power 4 Scout, and it comes with a permanent pilot all for deploy 3. And there's still room aboard for one more pilot. Why don'y you squeeze on in there and try her on for size! Add to that the fact that it is higher destiny than any other Tempest (equal to [[Blizzard Scout 1]]) and it is looking like the vehicle of choice for your [[Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest){{!}}Forest]] Moon!

And a little advice just between you and I - for a limited time only, this is the only AT-ST on the lot available with a metallic finish paint job.

Do you wish to arrange a line of credits through our Finance Department?
